source: Reference answers from Claude Opus 5.5 (medium effort), answered blind. Each case was given exactly the system prompt, user message and output schema the gateway sends to a Messages API upstream (captured from the gateway at 75eed5c), then mapped back through the gateway itself (normalization, choice, score, confidence, 2-decimal rounding). The without_user_instructions answers come from a separate agent that never saw the user_instructions variant.

reasons.customer_impact: Latency tripled with unchanged errors and six customer reports: mild to moderate impact.
reasons.latency_after_deploy: D-771 deployed 14:20 and symptoms first seen 14:31, 11 minutes later.
reasons.next_action: Rollback of the suspect deploy is best and allowed as an emergency change if within 60 minutes; the freeze timing is uncertain, so change-board escalation is the main alternative.

reasons.customer_impact: Checkout p95 latency tripled with 6 customer reports but errors unchanged; mild-to-moderate impact.
reasons.latency_after_deploy: D-771 deployed 14:20 and symptoms first seen 14:31, 11 minutes later.
reasons.next_action: Latency began right after D-771, so rollback is the strongest action; the active change freeze makes change-board escalation a real alternative, hotfix and restart weak.

without_user_instructions.note: The raw reference output was missing its final closing brace (invalid JSON); one '}' was appended before mapping. Values unchanged.

ui_dependence: The terminology defines which rollbacks count as allowed emergency changes during a freeze; without it the freeze may look like a blocker for the obvious fix.
